39333-curiosities-of-human-nature.creator: Unknown
39333-curiosities-of-human-nature.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Among the intellectual prodigies which sometimes appear to excite the wonder and astonishment of mankind, Zerah Colburn was certainly one of the most remarkable. He was born at Cabot, Vermont, Sept. He was the sixth child of his parents, who were persons in low circumstances and of little education.

arxiv-2011-06494.title: Polarization-controlled selective excitation of Mie resonances of dielectric nanoparticle on a coated substrate
arxiv-2011-06494.creator: D. A. Pidgayko, Z. F. Sadrieva, K. S. Ladutenko, A. A. Bogdanov
arxiv-2011-06494.description: Abstract Spherical high-index nanoparticles with low material losses support sharp high-Q electric and magnetic resonances and exhibit a number of interesting optical phenomena. Developments in fabrication techniques have enabled further study of their properties and the investigation of related optical effects. After deposition on a substrate, the optical properties of a particle change dramatically due to mutual interaction.

arxiv-2303-12589.title: Do Backdoors Assist Membership Inference Attacks?
arxiv-2303-12589.creator: 1 st Yumeki Goto, 2 nd Given Name Surname, 3 rd Given Name Surname, Yumeki Goto 1 , Nami Ashizawa 2 , Toshiki Shibahara 2 , Naoto Yanai 1
arxiv-2303-12589.description: Abstract When an adversary provides poison samples to a machine learning model, privacy leakage, such as membership inference attacks that infer whether a sample was included in the training of the model, becomes effective by moving the sample to an outlier. However, the attacks can be detected because inference accuracy deteriorates due to poison samples.

arxiv-2306-08716.title: Radiation-Induced Degradation Mechanism of X-ray SOI Pixel Sensors with Pinned Depleted Diode Structure
arxiv-2306-08716.creator: Kouichi Hagino, Masatoshi Kitajima, Takayoshi Kohmura, Ikuo Kurachi, Takeshi G. Tsuru, Masataka Yukumoto, Ayaki Takeda, Koji Mori, Yusuke Nishioka, Takaaki Tanaka
arxiv-2306-08716.description: Abstract The X-ray Silicon-On-Insulator (SOI) pixel sensor named XRPIX has been developed for the future X-ray astronomical satellite FORCE. XRPIX is capable of a wide-band X-ray imaging spectroscopy from below 1 keV to a few tens of keV with a good timing resolution of a few tens of 𝝁 \mu s.

arxiv-2308-08880.title: Continuous optical generation of microwave signals for fountain clocks
arxiv-2308-08880.creator: Burghard Lipphardt, Patrick Walkemeyer, Michael Kazda, Johannes Rahm and Stefan Weyers *
arxiv-2308-08880.description: Abstract For the optical generation of ultrastable microwave signals for fountain clocks we developed a setup, which is based on a cavity stabilized laser and a commercial frequency comb. The robust system, in operation since 2020, is locked to a 100 MHz output frequency of a hydrogen maser and provides an ultrastable 9.

arxiv-2404-03727.title: Waveguide quantum electrodynamics at the onset of spin-spin correlations
arxiv-2404-03727.creator: Sebastián Roca-Jerat, Marcos Rubín-Osanz, Mark D. Jenkins, Agustín Camón, Pablo J. Alonso, David Zueco, Fernando Luis
arxiv-2404-03727.description: Abstract We explore the competition between light-mediated and intrinsic matter-matter interactions in waveguide quantum electrodynamics. For this, we couple a superconducting transmission line to a model magnetic material, made of organic free radical molecules with a spin S = 1 / 2 S=1/2 and a g S g_{S} factor very close to that of a free electron.

arxiv-2405-09621.title: Extensive Pollution of Uranus and Neptune’s Atmospheres by Upsweep of Icy Material During the Nice Model Migration
arxiv-2405-09621.creator: Eva Zlimen, Elizabeth Bailey, Ruth Murray-Clay
arxiv-2405-09621.description: Abstract In the Nice model of solar system formation, Uranus and Neptune undergo an orbital upheaval, sweeping through a planetesimal disk. The region of the disk from which material is accreted by the ice giants during this phase of their evolution has not previously been identified.

arxiv-2408-00366.title: Singlet-Triplet Kondo Effect in Blatter Radical Molecular Junctions: Zero-bias Anomalies and Magnetoresistance
arxiv-2408-00366.description: Abstract The Blatter radical has been suggested as a building block in future molecular spintronic devices due to its radical character and expected long-spin lifetime. However, whether and how the radical character manifests itself in the charge transport and magnetotransport properties seems to depend on the environment or has not yet been studied.

arxiv-2411-03664.title: Interlayer Charge-density-wave Vector Phase Induced Structural Chirality
arxiv-2411-03664.creator: Sen Shao, Wei-Chi Chiu, Tao Hou, Naizhou Wang, Ilya Belopolski, Yilin Zhao, Jinyang Ni, Qi Zhang, Yongkai Li, Jinjin Liu, Mohammad Yahyavi, Yuanjun Jin, Qiange Feng, Peiyuan Cui, Cheng-Long Zhang, Yugui Yao, Zhiwei Wang, Jia-Xin Yin, Su-Yang Xu, Qiong Ma, Wei-bo Gao, Md Shafayat Hossain, Arun Bansil
arxiv-2411-03664.description: Abstract Chiral charge density waves (CDWs) have attracted intense interest due to their exotic quantum properties, yet the microscopic origin of structural chirality emerging from correlated charge order remains elusive. Here, we reveal that the interlayer phases of CDW wave vectors, an overlooked degree of freedom, play a crucial role in driving chiral structural displacements in layered CDW materials.

arxiv-2503-09763.title: BiasConnect : Investigating Bias Interactions in Text-to-Image Models
arxiv-2503-09763.creator: Pushkar Shukla Aditya Chinchure Emily Diana Alexander Tolbert, Kartik Hosanagar Vineeth N. Balasubramanian Leonid Sigal Matthew A. Turk
arxiv-2503-09763.description: Abstract The biases exhibited by Text-to-Image (TTI) models are often treated as if they are independent, but in reality, they may be deeply interrelated. Addressing bias along one dimension, such as ethnicity or age, can inadvertently influence another dimension, like gender, either mitigating or exacerbating existing disparities.

arxiv-2506-18908.title: Proof of admissible weights
arxiv-2506-18908.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . Admissable weight is an important tool for studying spectral invariance in operator algebra. Common admissable weights include polynomial weights and sub exponential weights. This article mainly provides a proof that polynomial weights are permissible weights.

pmc-10572089.title: Sleep-inducing effect of Rhynchophylline in EphA4 knockout mice
pmc-10572089.creator: Maria Neus Ballester Roig, Valérie Mongrain
pmc-10572089.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). We have recently demonstrated that the alkaloid rhynchophylline (RHY; purified from Uncaria plants) induces sleep and modifies electrocorticographic (ECoG) activity throughout the 24-h day in a vigilance state-dependent manner in wild-type mice. We here asked whether this alkaloid impacts wake/sleep variables in the absence of the cell adhesion protein EPHA4, via ECoG recording in EphA4 knockout (KO) mice submitted to the same RHY treatment contemporaneously to the wild-type mice (littermates).

pmc-11370798.title: CSF1R inhibition depletes brain macrophages and reduces brain virus burden in SIV-infected macaques
pmc-11370798.creator: Diana G Bohannon, Laurent D Zablocki-Thomas, Evan S Leung, Jinbum K Dupont, Julian B Hattler, Jolanta Kowalewska, Miaoyun Zhao, Jiangtao Luo, Marco Salemi, Angela M Amedee, Qingsheng Li, Marcelo J Kuroda, Woong-Ki Kim
pmc-11370798.description: Perivascular macrophages (PVMs) and, to a lesser degree, microglia are targets and reservoirs of HIV and simian immunodeficiency virus (SIV) in the brain. Previously, we demonstrated that colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor (CSF1R) in PVMs was upregulated and activated in chronically SIV-infected rhesus macaques with encephalitis, correlating with SIV infection of PVMs.

pmc-11478827.title: Prediabetes increases the risk of pancreatic cancer: A meta-analysis of longitudinal observational studies
pmc-11478827.creator: Xuefang Huang, Huan Li, Lisha Zhao, Lingli Xu, Hui Long
pmc-11478827.description: BackgroundGlycemic disorder is closely related to the risk of pancreatic cancer, but previous studies focused on the influence of diabetes. The aim of this meta-analysis was to investigate the influence of prediabetes, an intermediate state between normoglycemia and diabetes, on the risk of pancreatic cancer.

pmc-11512550.title: Surface-functionalized PAN fiber membranes for the sensitive detection of airborne specific markers
pmc-11512550.creator: Leontyna Varvarovska, Bruno Sopko, Dana Gaskova, Tomas Bartl, Evzen Amler, Tatana Jarosikova
pmc-11512550.description: PAN fibers are characterized by having a large surface-to-volume ratio and small pores, which are beneficial for applications in filtration and specific molecular detection systems. Naturally, larger items are filtered, and a lower ratio between specific and nonspecific binding is expected since small pores do not allow larger elements to penetrate through membranes; thus, nonspecific binding is enhanced.

pmc-12439153.title: Protocol for the SUPPORTED study: a Danish multicentre complex intervention for first-time fathers of preterm infants
pmc-12439153.creator: Kristina Garne Holm, Mai-Britt Hägi-Pedersen, Helle Haslund-Thomsen, Ingrid Nilsson, Hanne Aagaard, Ragnhild Maastrup, Camilla Ejlertsen, Mette Petersen, Maria Monberg Feenstra, Ingeborg Kristensen, Anne Brødsgaard
pmc-12439153.description: IntroductionFathers of preterm infants wish to be actively involved and attentive in caring for their children. The positive impacts of paternal caregiving on preterm infants’ cognitive and social development have been recognised. Awareness of the need to support fathers during early parenthood is increasing, but fathers may feel excluded when their infants are in the neonatal intensive care unit.

pmc-12649112.title: Knowledge, Perceptions, and Behaviors Regarding Antibiotic Use in a Community-Based Adult Sample in Salerno: An Observational Survey in a Province in Southern Italy
pmc-12649112.creator: Emanuela Santoro, Raffaele Amelio, Roberta Manente, Giuseppina Speziga, Antonio Donato, Mario Capunzo, Giovanni Boccia
pmc-12649112.description: Background/Objectives: Antibiotic resistance represents one of the major global health emergencies, driven by the inappropriate use of antibiotics and persistent misconceptions among adults attending general medical clinics. This study, conducted on 325 participants recruited from general medical clinics in the province of Salerno, aimed to assess their knowledge, perceptions, and behaviors regarding antibiotic use.

pmc-13371131.title: Comprehensive analysis of TGA genes in barley: structure, evolution, and stress-responsive expression
pmc-13371131.creator: Bahman Panahi, Rasmieh Hamid, Zahra Ghorbanzadeh, Komal G Lakhani, Feba Jacob
pmc-13371131.description: BackgroundTGA transcription factors (bZIP family) are central to hormone signalling and stress responses in plants. However, their genomic organization and regulatory potential in barley (Hordeum vulgare L.) remain insufficiently characterised.ResultsA total of 49 HvTGA genes were identified, which are unevenly distributed across the barley genome, with the most prominent clusters located on chromosomes 3 H and 5 H.

uslaw-usc-t18-s218.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 11 (Bribery, Graft, And Conflicts Of Interest). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In addition to any other remedies provided by law the President or, under regulations prescribed by him, the head of any department or agency involved, may declare void and rescind any contract, loan, grant, subsidy, license, right.
